decision.reasoning_trace: In this shopping session, I am looking for a functional and durable backpack suitable for day hiking. I filtered the product feed to find legitimate backpacks rather than camping accessories. My consideration set includes a wide range of options: a high-end technical winter pack (USWE 30L), a large expedition-sized pack (High Sierra 70L), a budget-friendly packable daypack (HIKPRO 20L), a basic hydration-focused pack (UDIHEDA), and a specialized hiking daypack (KAILAS 28L). I ultimately decided to purchase the KAILAS 28L because it offers professional features like an internal frame and an included rain cover for a mid-range price. The reviews specifically mentioned it as a high-quality 'dupe' for premium brands, providing high value for the cost compared to the more expensive USWE or the less structured HIKPRO.
